item.title: Morning brief, Friday November 20
item.description: Good morning, Sydney. Happy Friday. You're in Las Vegas for race weekend. Your one big thing today is showing up at Investing with Intention at noon, the session on tax planning and mission-focused investing. Open the Luma email this morning for the venue and gate details, and have your one-line pitch for Influencer Designer AI ready. If you'd rather rest, skipping it is fine, since this is a vacation day too. Two quick must-dos: send Tina on Vrbo a quick yes, because she wants to text tomorrow evening with a viewing time and it may move to Sunday. And your home alarm system sent a low battery alert this morning, so ask someone to swap the battery when they can. Also, United logged your lost item report, and they'll search for thirty days. Weather in Las Vegas: clear and cool this morning, in the mid forties, warming to around fifty seven this afternoon with a small chance of a passing shower. It's back near the upper forties by evening, so bring a warm layer. You have no flights today. Enjoy the weekend.
